items.title: How Investors May Respond To Ventas Stock After Higher Earnings Guidance

The guidance increase is tied mainly to accretive senior housing investment activity. items.title: America Is Running Out of Senior Housing. These 3 REITs Could Cash In
items.summary: Nearly 70 million boomers are turning 80 while new senior housing construction crawls near record lows. Three healthcare REITs sit in the middle of that squeeze, but only one pays a big yield, and it leaves the thinnest margin for error.

items.title: Senior Housing Demand Is Rising. Can These 4 REITs Turn It Into Bigger Dividends?
items.summary: Baby boomers are turning 80 while builders put up almost no new senior housing, a setup that pushes rents and occupancy higher. But operator costs and government reimbursement decide how much profit actually reaches shareholders, and these four REITs handle that risk very differently.

items.title: What Ventas (VTR) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.summary: Ventas (NYSE:VTR) reported third-quarter results marked by continued growth in its senior housing operating portfolio, increased investment activity and a higher full-year earnings outlook, as the company emphasized demand from an aging U.S. population and limited new senior housing supply.
